timeline.rule: NEVER cut, re-time or shorten the user's clip - output must equal the requested timestamp duration exactly
timeline.note: 9-shot/16.2s cut reel was rejected; full continuous versions approved (40s and 36s clips)

resolution_policy.rule: Use the highest resolution the source offers at 60fps. Default is 1440p60; if 2160p60 (4K) or higher is available, use that instead.
resolution_policy.aspect: vertical 9:16 - always downscale height to width*16/9 (1440x2560, 2160x3840)
resolution_policy.source_policy: Download the highest-resolution 60fps format available via yt-dlp -F; check the format list before downloading
resolution_policy.scaling: All layout coords in this preset are in a 1080x1920 base space. Multiply every coord by (output_width/1080). Source crop coords are in a 1920x1080 base space - multiply by (source_width/1920). Caption renderer scale = output_width/1080.
resolution_policy.verified_example: 2560x1440 source -> 1440x2560 output: facecam crop (0,467,667,973), split y=1093, gameplay crop x 584-2024

canvas.note: 1440p60 default; upgrade to 2160p60 when source offers it - see resolution_policy

facecam.note: slightly smaller, wider view, face centred - earlier tight 320x280 crop rejected
facecam.per_clip_detection: REQUIRED: the facecam is NOT always top-left. Run face detection on several frames of the new source; find the consistent face cluster(s), frame them centred with a wider view, and confirm the location with the user via a labeled grid preview before building the storyboard.

gameplay.note: tight centre crop: scale full source frame so its height equals the bottom panel height, then centre-crop to output width

captions.display: whole cue at once; fade entire cue in/out over 0.10 s (word-by-word was reverted: sync gaps and missing text on speech frames)

emoji.inline_position: between words of the dense line

karaoke_highlight.display: full caption visible from cue start in dimmed state; each word eases to full brightness in sequence
karaoke_highlight.timing_source: per-word times mapped from whisper word timestamps

word_by_word_reveal.reason: per-word fade-in caused sync gaps and missing text on speech frames

caption_profiles.compositing_rule: PIL overlays are RGB, cv2 frames are BGR - convert frame to RGB, composite, convert back (a past render swapped them and broke caption colors)

sound.sfx_extraction: fetch https://www.myinstants.com/en/instant/<slug>/ and take the first /media/sounds/*.mp3 link; download with a browser User-Agent
sound.placement: SPARSE — meme SFX only at genuinely crazy moments (screams, OH NO, frustration, chaotic peak); voice stays on top; no bed. Supersedes old 120 BPM beat + synth pack.
